title: MVMR: A New Framework for Evaluating Faithfulness of Video Moment Retrieval against Multiple Distractors

problems.name: Annotation Scarcity and Noisy Supervision
problems.evidence_sentence: To solve the task, we further propose a strong informative sample-weighted learning method, CroCs, which employs two contrastive learning mechanisms: (1) weakly-supervised potential negative learning and (2) cross-directional hard-negative learning.

problems.name: Dataset, Benchmark, and Evaluation Mismatch
problems.evidence_sentence: The most critical challenge in converting a VMR dataset into an MVMR dataset is accurately categorizing positive and negative videos for each query.

problems.name: Multi-Moment, Compositional, and Complex Query Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: This problem also arises in a practical video moment retrieval scenario, Video Corpus Moment Retrieval (VCMR), which aims to search for a relevant video moment within a pool of multiple videos [5, 12, 14, 18].

methods.name: Benchmark or Dataset Construction
methods.evidence_sentence: Specifically, we categorize positive and negative videos for a specific query from the whole video set of a VMR dataset to construct a massive video set.

methods.name: Contrastive or Cross-Modal Alignment
